meta.title: Gum Treatment | The British Dental Hub
meta.description: Comprehensive periodontal care in Cairo, from preventive deep cleaning to advanced gum disease treatment and crown lengthening.

hero.subtitle: Comprehensive periodontal care planned around your needs, from preventive maintenance to more advanced gum treatment — delivered with the same measured, clinician-led approach as every treatment here.

types.title: Types of Gum Treatment
types.subtitle: The right approach depends on your specific gum health, from routine maintenance to more advanced periodontal care.

deepCleaning.title: Deep Cleaning
deepCleaning.subtitle: Scaling & Root Planing
deepCleaning.description: A thorough, deep clean beneath the gumline that removes plaque and tartar to support healthier gums.
deepCleaning.note: Ideal for: early gum concerns and routine periodontal maintenance

laser.title: Laser Gum Treatment
laser.description: Laser-assisted treatment, used when clinically appropriate, for greater precision and a more comfortable recovery.
laser.note: Ideal for: cases where a targeted, minimally invasive approach is suitable

gingivitis.title: Gingivitis & Periodontitis Treatment
gingivitis.description: Structured care for gum inflammation at every stage, from early gingivitis to more advanced periodontal disease.
gingivitis.note: Ideal for: ongoing gum health, at whatever stage treatment is needed

crownLengthening.title: Crown Lengthening
crownLengthening.description: A precise procedure that reshapes the gumline, often used to prepare for restorative or cosmetic dental work.
crownLengthening.note: Ideal for: patients preparing for crowns, veneers, or a more balanced smile line

item1.quote: My gums feel healthier than they have in years, and every stage of the treatment was explained clearly and calmly.

item2.quote: I appreciated how thorough the assessment was before anything was recommended — nothing felt rushed.

item3.quote: The team made a treatment I was nervous about feel genuinely comfortable and well managed.

consultationCta.title: Ready for Healthier Gums?
consultationCta.description: Every periodontal treatment begins with a comprehensive consultation. We'll assess your gum health, explain every available option, and shape a personalised treatment plan around your needs.
consultationCta.noPressure: No pressure. Just honest clinical advice.
consultationCta.contactNote: Our team will personally contact you to arrange your consultation at a convenient time.
